rows.label: inkling-recipe
rows.source: vLLM's own recipe for thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini (recipes/models/thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini.yaml, read 23 Nov 2026): --tensor-parallel-size 1, the bundled DSpark drafter at 7 tokens with probabilistic drafting, --max-model-len 262144 on H100; every other setting vLLM's default on this card (max_num_seqs 1,024 on an H100: engine/arg_utils.py, so stated; max_num_batched_tokens 8,192 and the memory fraction left unset). The reasoning parser it adds changes how replies are split, not what is generated or how fast.
